english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something while angry.

exampleSentences.english: I angrily scolded him and told him not to be late again.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我嬲住鬧佢，叫佢唔好再遲到。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 nau1 zyu6 naau6 keoi5 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 zoi3 ci4 dou3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when someone does something angrily.

exampleSentences.english: They furiously scolded me, saying I shouldn't have done that.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢嬲住鬧我，話我唔應該咁做。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 nau1 zyu6 naau6 ngo5 waa6 ngo5 m4 jing1 goi1 gam3 zou6
